title: Autonomous Haul Truck Reportedly Went Down an Embankment After Communications Loss at Copper Mine in Antofagasta, Chile
summary: An autonomous haul truck designated unit 207 at Minera Centinela, a copper mine in Chile's Antofagasta Region, reportedly lost communications before going down an embankment during a mining operation. The mine activated emergency protocols and isolated the area. No injuries were reported. Investigators had not determined the cause or the extent of vehicle damage, and a causal link to the communications loss remained unconfirmed.
